{{Locations|Slug Controlled Nebula|Slug Home Nebula|nebula=true|LRSmap=noship+nebula|unique=true}}


''You are immediately hailed by a dangerous looking ship. "I'm feeling generouss today. I shall allow you to choose your own death. Which do you like leasst: shields, oxygen, or weaponsss?"''
# Shields.
#* ''"Very good then!" Your shield power suddenly drops and they charge.''
#** Fight a [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] with your <span style="color:red">{{Tooltip|Shields halved|rounds down against you}}</span>.
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and your shields return to normal. You collect what you can.}}
#**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
#*** {{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your shields return to normal. You strip the ship.}}
#**** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
# Oxygen.
#* ''"A being that would choose sssuffocation? Who am I to judge..." Your life support shuts off and they move in to attack.''
#** Fight a [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] with your <span style="color:red">{{Tooltip|Oxygen system halved|rounds down against you}}</span>.
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and your systems return to normal. You collect what you can.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your systems return to normal. You strip the ship.}}
#**** You receive medium [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
# Weapons.
#* ''"Your acceptance of death is almosst admirable... Almosst." Your weapons system registers a hacking module. You hardly have time to respond before they attack.''
#** Fight a [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] with your <span style="color:red">{{Tooltip|Weapon Control halved|rounds down against you}}</span>.
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and your weapon system returns to normal. You collect what you can.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your weapon system returns to normal. You strip the ship.}}
#**** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].
# Offer 35 scrap to leave you alone. &nbsp;[ {{Transaction|35|subtract_scrap}} ]
#* ''"I really am feeling generousss..." They take the scrap and leave.''
#** You avoided the fight.
# {{Blue Option|Hacking System|Counter any hack attempt.|shortreq=Hacking}}
#* ''"Sssilence won't protect you. I'll make the choice mysself... Wait. Why isn't this working?" You cut transmission and move in to attack.''
#** Fight a [[Slug Ships|Slug ship]] with your <span style="color:red">Hacking offline</span>. 
#*** {{Winning|destroyed=true|The Slug ship breaks apart and their hacking module is destroyed. You collect what you can.}}<br />{{Winning|deadCrew=true|With their crew dead, you quickly shut off their hacking module and your weapon system [sic] returns to normal. You strip the ship.}}
#**** You receive high [[Rewards#Standard|scrap with resources]].

==Trivia==
This event is called "NEBULA_SLUG_CHOOSE_DEATH" in the datafiles.
* The "Shields" hack option can be chosen despite having no Shields system.
* The "Oxygen" hack option doesn't fully disable upgraded Oxygen system. (it works the same way as Oxygen lv2+ blue option in [[Slug hacker (oxygen)]] event)
* The "Weapons" hack option doesn't affect [[Artillery Beam]] or [[Flak Artillery]] systems.
